questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “abundant”?
questions.e: Abundant means there is a lot of something; plentiful has the same meaning.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “accomplish”?
questions.e: To accomplish something is to achieve it.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “adapt”?
questions.e: To adapt is to adjust to a new situation.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “admire”?
questions.e: To admire someone is to respect them.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “annual”?
questions.e: Annual means happening once every year.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “apparent”?
questions.e: Apparent means easy to see or understand; obvious is close in meaning.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “attempt”?
questions.e: An attempt is an effort to do something; to attempt is to try.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “benefit”?
questions.e: A benefit is a helpful result or an advantage.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “challenge” in “Learning a new language is a challenge”?
questions.e: Here, a challenge is something difficult to do.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “consequence”?
questions.e: A consequence is a result of an action.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “conserve water”?
questions.e: To conserve water is to use it carefully and save it.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “demonstrate”?
questions.e: To demonstrate something is to show how it works.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “determine”?
questions.e: To determine something is to decide or find it out.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “encourage”?
questions.e: To encourage someone is to give them confidence or motivation.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “evaluate”?
questions.e: To evaluate something is to assess its quality or value.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “fortunate”?
questions.e: A fortunate person is lucky.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “maintain” in “maintain a clean classroom”?
questions.e: Here, maintain means to keep something in good condition.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “prevent”?
questions.e: To prevent something is to stop it from happening.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “reliable”?
questions.e: A reliable person or thing can be depended on.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “similar”?
questions.e: Similar things are alike, but not always exactly the same.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “sufficient”?
questions.e: Sufficient means as much as is needed; enough means the same.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “transform”?
questions.e: To transform something is to change it.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “valuable”?
questions.e: Something valuable is worth a lot or is precious.

questions.q: What is the closest meaning of “willing” in “She is willing to help”?
questions.e: If she is willing, she is ready to help.
